reason: A native DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a configurable animated whale companion, reflects structured session activity, displays current conversation progress, and optionally provides a floating desktop window.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可拖动、可配置的像素鲸鱼伴侣，用于展示会话状态和对话进度，并支持可选的浮动桌面窗口。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable draggable pixel whale to DeepSeek Harness that reflects session activity, shows conversation progress, and can optionally run in a floating desktop window.

capabilities: Reads structured Harness session signals to determine visual states
Displays the latest local prompt and Harness reply in an in-page pet card
Submits explicitly entered follow-up text to the current Harness session
Stores interface settings and pet position in browser localStorage
Optionally opens the pet in a Chromium Document Picture-in-Picture window
